hn-bhieegee-ouw ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT of the I day of A, 2007, by and between EIGHTH AVENUE SKY, LLC, a New York limited liability cohpany having an address at 58 East Palisade Avenue, Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey 07631(hereinafter referred to as “Transferor") and 303 WEST 46TH STREET LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an address at 391 Broadway, 5h Floor, New York, New York 10013 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as and in Exhibit A-1annexed hereto and made a part of hereof and known as tax lot, Block 1037, Lot 35 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Transferor's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter collectively referred to as the “"Transferor's Building", and Transferor's Land and Transferor's Building being hereinafter collectively referred to jointly as the “Transferor's Property"); and WHEREAS, Developer is the owner infee title to certain parcels of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 763Eighth Avenue, New York,New York and more particularly described Block 1037, Lot 34 (said parcel of land and tax lot being collectively referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter collectively referred to as “Developer's Building", and Developer's Land and Developer's Building being hereinafter collectively referred to as “Developer's Property"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto believe that there exist Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to Transferor's Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Transferor's Building and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined); and WHEREAS, Developer desires either (i) to demolish the existing buildings located on Developer's Land and construct thereon a new building and/or (ii) to alter the existing building(s) located on Developer's Land (such new and/or altered building being referred to herein as the “"New Building") having a bulk (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the buik presently permitted to be constructed on Developer's Land under the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, in order to construct the New Building with bulk in excess of the bulk presently permitted to be constructed on Developer's Land it is necessary for Developer to acquire certain Available Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) from Transferor's Land and also to acquire development rights from the owners of other land adjacent to Transferor's Property orDeveloper'sProperty; and SS _INITIAL 1

WHEREAS, Transferor is willing to permit Developer to utilize the Available Development Rights on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth for the consideration set forth herein, it being understood and agreed, however, that Transferor shall retain for Transferor's own benefit all Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined); and WHEREAS, Transferor and Developer are, respectively, parties-in-interest (as hereinafter defined) with respect to Transferor's Land and Developer's Land, respectively and such parties desire to have Transferor's Land and Developer's Land declared a Single Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) for the purposes of the Zoning Resolution and to create certain restrictions with regard to such lots; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or other action from the other; and WHEREAS, all Parties-in-Interest (as hereinafter defined) to the Single Zoning Lot, as shown on the Parties-in-Interest Certification(as hereinafter defined) have executed this Agreement or have waived or subordinated their interests thereto and such waivers and subordinations are attached as “Exhibit D", annexed hereto and made a part hereof. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained andothervaluable consideration,the mutual receipt and legal sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1.Definitions. For the purpose of this Agreement (including all schedules and exhibits annexed hereto), capitalized terms used in this Agreement (whether or not otherwise defined herein) shall have thefollowing meaning: A. “Actual ADR" shall mean the actual amount of square feet of Available Development Rights, determined by a licensed architect, engineer or surveyor, subject to adjustment, pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement. B.‘ “Additional Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the unused Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to any other parcel of land not currently owned by Transferor or Developer which Developer contracts to acquire or does acquire from and after the date of thisAgreement. C.“Available Development Rights" shall mean all of (i) the Floor Area Development Rights for any permitted use appurtenant to Transferor's Land as of the date of Closing, less (i) the amount of Retained Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined).
